The Ontario Hockey League is excited to relaunch a new weekly feature for the 2025-26 season – OHL Plays of the Week presented by Dairy Farmers of Ontario. Every Wednesday, fans can look forward to seeing the very best moments from across the league, with one standout highlight chosen from each of the OHL’s four divisions: East, Central, Midwest and West. These four plays will go head-to-head in a weekly showcase of the skill, speed, and creativity that define OHL hockey. How It Works Each week, the OHL league office will select one standout play from every division. The four divisional winners will be featured together in one highlight package, released every Wednesday across OHL digital platforms. Fans will then cast their vote on Instagram, X, and the OHL website to decide which division produced the top play of the week. From highlight-reel goals to game-saving stops, Plays of the Week will showcase the skill that OHL players bring to the ice every night, with divisional bragging rights on the line! Stay tuned every Wednesday for the latest edition of OHL Plays of the Week presented by Dairy Farmers of Ontario – and make your vote count.
